104: 			"%w\nConsult with release notes to see if any fields were changed/removed", err,
105: 		)
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	c.Config.Topology.ImportEnvsFrom(c.topologyEnv)
109: 
110: 	return nil
111: }

113: func mergeTemplateVariables(dst, src any) any {
114: 	dstMap, dstOK := dst.(map[string]any)
115: 	srcMap, srcOK := src.(map[string]any)
116: 
117: 	if !dstOK || !srcOK {
118: 		// For non-maps, src overrides dst
119: 		return src
120: 	}
121: 
122: 	for key, srcVal := range srcMap {
123: 		if dstVal, exists := dstMap[key]; exists {
124: 			dstMap[key] = mergeTemplateVariables(dstVal, srcVal)
125: 		} else {
126: 			dstMap[key] = srcVal
127: 		}
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	return dstMap
131: }

133: func findVarsFiles(paths *clabtypes.TopoPaths) ([]string, error) {
134: 	topo_dir := paths.TopologyFileDir()
135: 	vars_search_glob := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s.*", paths.TopologyFilenameWithoutExt(), varFileSuffix)
136: 	// e.g. lab_a.clab_vars.*
137: 
138: 	// this will find both lab_a.clab_vars.yml, as well as lab_a.clab_vars.additions.yml;
139: 	// their values will be merged in alphabetical order
140: 	fsys := os.DirFS(topo_dir)
141: 
142: 	valid_exts := []string{".yaml", ".yml", ".json"}
143: 
144: 	result := []string{}
145: 	candidates, err := fs.Glob(fsys, vars_search_glob)
146: 	if err != nil {
147: 		return nil, err
148: 	}
149: 	for _, candidate := range candidates {
150: 		candidate_ext := filepath.Ext(candidate)
151: 		if slices.Contains(valid_exts, candidate_ext) {
152: 			result = append(result, filepath.Join(topo_dir, candidate))
153: 		}
154: 	}
155: 
156: 	return result, nil
157: }
158: 
159: func readTemplateVariables(paths *clabtypes.TopoPaths, varsFiles []string) (any, error) {
160: 	if len(varsFiles) == 0 {
161: 		log.Debug("searching for template vars files")
162: 		foundFiles, err := findVarsFiles(paths)
163: 		if err != nil {
164: 			return nil, err
165: 		}
166: 
167: 		if len(foundFiles) == 0 {
168: 			// no var file found, assume the topology is not a template
169: 			// or a template that doesn't require external variables
170: 			return nil, nil
171: 		}
172: 		varsFiles = foundFiles
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	log.Debug("template vars", "files", varsFiles)
176: 
177: 	templateVars := make(map[string]any)
178: 	// read all requested var files, and merge their contents into one:
179: 	for _, varsFile := range varsFiles {
180: 		// skip empty vars file names
181: 		if len(varsFile) == 0 {
182: 			continue
183: 		}
184: 
185: 		data, err := os.ReadFile(varsFile)
186: 		if err != nil {
187: 			return nil, err
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		var parsedVars map[string]any
191: 		err = yaml.Unmarshal(data, &parsedVars)
192: 		if err != nil {
193: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("variables file '%s': %w", filepath.Base(varsFile), err)
194: 		}
195: 		mergeTemplateVariables(templateVars, parsedVars)
196: 	}
197: 
198: 	return templateVars, nil
199: }

105: type stagedConfigMapMount struct {
106: 	nodeName      string
107: 	filePath      string
108: 	configMapName string
109: 	configMapPath string
110: 	mode          string
111: }
112: 
113: type stagedLocalFile struct {
114: 	filePath string
115: 	mode     string
116: 	content  []byte
117: }
118: 
119: func stageTopologyLocalFiles(
120: 	ctx context.Context,
121: 	req clablabruntime.DeployRequest,
122: ) ([]byte, []stagedConfigMap, string, error) {
123: 	config := &clabRuntimeConfig{}
124: 	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(req.TopologyDefinition, config); err != nil {
125: 		return nil, nil, "", fmt.Errorf(
126: 			"failed to parse rendered topology for clabernetes preparation: %w",
127: 			err,
128: 		)
129: 	}
130: 
131: 	naming := clabernetesNamingMode(config)
132: 	if config.Topology == nil || len(config.Topology.Nodes) == 0 {
133: 		return req.TopologyDefinition, nil, naming, nil
134: 	}
135: 
136: 	configMaps := map[string]*stagedConfigMap{}
137: 	// Always render parsed links through the c9s brief-link boundary so an extended link's
138: 	// behavior does not depend on whether some unrelated field changed the definition.
139: 	definitionChanged := len(config.Topology.Links) > 0
140: 
141: 	nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(config.Topology.Nodes))
142: 	for nodeName := range config.Topology.Nodes {
143: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
144: 	}
145: 	sort.Strings(nodeNames)
146: 
147: 	if req.TopologyFile != "" {
148: 		topologyFileDir := filepath.Dir(req.TopologyFile)
149: 		topologyLabDir := req.TopologyLabDir
150: 		if topologyLabDir == "" && config.Name != "" {
151: 			topologyLabDir = filepath.Join(topologyFileDir, "clab-"+config.Name)
152: 		}
153: 
154: 		for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
155: 			if err := stageStartupConfig(
156: 				ctx,
157: 				config,
158: 				req.Name,
159: 				nodeName,
160: 				topologyFileDir,
161: 				topologyLabDir,
162: 				configMaps,
163: 				&definitionChanged,
164: 			); err != nil {
165: 				return nil, nil, "", err
166: 			}
167: 
168: 			if err := stageLicenseFile(
169: 				ctx,
170: 				config,
171: 				req.Name,
172: 				nodeName,
173: 				topologyFileDir,
174: 				topologyLabDir,
175: 				configMaps,
176: 				&definitionChanged,
177: 			); err != nil {
178: 				return nil, nil, "", err
179: 			}
180: 
181: 			if err := stageBindFiles(
182: 				config,
183: 				req.Name,
184: 				nodeName,
185: 				topologyFileDir,
186: 				topologyLabDir,
187: 				configMaps,
188: 			); err != nil {
189: 				return nil, nil, "", err
190: 			}
191: 
192: 			if err := stageAdditionalNodeFiles(
193: 				config,
194: 				req.Name,
195: 				nodeName,
196: 				topologyFileDir,
197: 				topologyLabDir,
198: 				configMaps,
199: 			); err != nil {
200: 				return nil, nil, "", err
201: 			}
202: 		}
203: 	}
204: 
205: 	// Sanitizing after the local files are staged keeps the file lookups on the paths the node
206: 	// names in the topology file spell out, while everything sent to Kubernetes uses the renamed
207: 	// nodes.
208: 	renames, definitionsChanged, err := sanitizeNodeNames(config, nodeNames)
209: 	if err != nil {
210: 		return nil, nil, "", err
211: 	}
212: 	if definitionsChanged {
213: 		definitionChanged = true
214: 	}
215: 
216: 	topologyDefinition := req.TopologyDefinition
217: 	if definitionChanged {
218: 		updatedDefinition, err := renderClabernetesTopologyDefinition(config, renames)
219: 		if err != nil {
220: 			return nil, nil, "", fmt.Errorf(
221: 				"failed to render updated clabernetes topology definition: %w",
222: 				err,
223: 			)
224: 		}
225: 		topologyDefinition = updatedDefinition
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	stagedConfigMaps := collectStagedConfigMaps(configMaps)
229: 	renameStagedConfigMapNodes(stagedConfigMaps, renames)
230: 
231: 	return topologyDefinition, stagedConfigMaps, naming, nil
232: }
233: 
234: func renderClabernetesTopologyDefinition(
235: 	config *clabRuntimeConfig,
236: 	renames map[string]string,
237: ) ([]byte, error) {
238: 	if config == nil {
239: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("topology config is nil")
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	rendered := &clabernetesRenderConfig{
243: 		Name:     config.Name,
244: 		Prefix:   config.Prefix,
245: 		Mgmt:     config.Mgmt,
246: 		Settings: config.Settings,
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if config.Topology != nil {
250: 		links, err := clabernetesBriefLinks(
251: 			config.Topology.Links,
252: 			defaultMgmtNetwork(config.Mgmt),
253: 		)
254: 		if err != nil {
255: 			return nil, err
256: 		}
257: 		renameBriefLinkEndpoints(links, renames)
258: 
259: 		rendered.Topology = &clabernetesRenderTopology{
260: 			Defaults: config.Topology.Defaults,
261: 			Kinds:    config.Topology.Kinds,
262: 			Nodes:    config.Topology.Nodes,
263: 			Groups:   config.Topology.Groups,
264: 			Links:    links,
265: 		}
266: 	}
267: 
268: 	return yaml.Marshal(rendered)
269: }
270: 
271: func clabernetesBriefLinks(
272: 	links []*clablinks.LinkDefinition,
273: 	mgmtNetwork string,
274: ) ([]*clablinks.LinkBriefRaw, error) {
275: 	if len(links) == 0 {
276: 		return nil, nil
277: 	}
278: 
279: 	briefLinks := make([]*clablinks.LinkBriefRaw, 0, len(links))
280: 	for _, link := range links {
281: 		if link == nil || link.Link == nil {
282: 			continue
283: 		}
284: 
285: 		brief, err := clabernetesBriefLink(link, mgmtNetwork)
286: 		if err != nil {
287: 			return nil, err
288: 		}
289: 		briefLinks = append(briefLinks, brief)
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	return briefLinks, nil
293: }
294: 
295: func clabernetesBriefLink(
296: 	link *clablinks.LinkDefinition,
297: 	mgmtNetwork string,
298: ) (*clablinks.LinkBriefRaw, error) {
299: 	switch raw := link.Link.(type) {
300: 	case *clablinks.LinkBriefRaw:
301: 		return raw, nil
302: 	case *clablinks.LinkVEthRaw:
303: 		return raw.ToLinkBriefRaw(), nil
304: 	case *clablinks.LinkHostRaw:
305: 		return raw.ToLinkBriefRaw(), nil
306: 	case *clablinks.LinkMgmtNetRaw:
307: 		// the brief form has no network field, it always attaches to the default
308: 		// management network
309: 		if raw.Network != "" && raw.Network != mgmtNetwork {
310: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
311: 				"clabernetes runtime supports mgmt-net links to the default management "+
312: 					"network %q only, not to %q",
313: 				mgmtNetwork,
314: 				raw.Network,
315: 			)
316: 		}
317: 		return raw.ToLinkBriefRaw(), nil
318: 	case *clablinks.LinkMacVlanRaw:
319: 		return raw.ToLinkBriefRaw(), nil
320: 	default:
321: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
322: 			"failed to render clabernetes-compatible brief link for %s link",
323: 			link.Link.GetType(),
324: 		)
325: 	}
326: }
327: 
328: // defaultMgmtNetwork returns the name of the management network of the topology,
329: // falling back to the name containerlab uses when the topology does not set one.
330: func defaultMgmtNetwork(mgmt *clabtypes.MgmtNet) string {
331: 	if mgmt == nil || mgmt.Network == "" {
332: 		return clabconstants.DefaultMgmtNetworkName
333: 	}
334: 	return mgmt.Network
335: }
336: 
337: func clabernetesNamingMode(config *clabRuntimeConfig) string {
338: 	if config == nil || config.Prefix == nil || *config.Prefix != "" {
339: 		return ""
340: 	}
341: 
342: 	return clabernetesNamingNonPrefixed
343: }
344: 
345: func stageStartupConfig(
346: 	ctx context.Context,
347: 	config *clabRuntimeConfig,
348: 	topologyName,
349: 	nodeName,
350: 	topologyFileDir,
351: 	topologyLabDir string,
352: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
353: 	definitionChanged *bool,
354: ) error {
355: 	startupConfig := config.Topology.GetNodeStartupConfig(nodeName)
356: 	if startupConfig == "" {
357: 		return nil
358: 	}
359: 
360: 	if strings.Contains(startupConfig, "\n") {
361: 		nodeDefinition := config.Topology.Nodes[nodeName]
362: 		if nodeDefinition == nil {
363: 			nodeDefinition = &clabtypes.NodeDefinition{}
364: 			config.Topology.Nodes[nodeName] = nodeDefinition
365: 		}
366: 		nodeDefinition.StartupConfig = inlineStartupConfigMountPath
367: 		*definitionChanged = true
368: 
369: 		return stageConfigMapFile(
370: 			configMaps,
371: 			topologyName,
372: 			"inline-startup-config/"+nodeName,
373: 			nodeName,
374: 			inlineStartupConfigMountPath,
375: 			fileModeRead,
376: 			[]byte(startupConfig),
377: 		)
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	resolvedStartupConfig, files, err := resolveNodeFileReference(
381: 		ctx, startupConfig, "startup-config", nodeName, topologyFileDir, topologyLabDir,
382: 	)
383: 	if err != nil {
384: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed staging startup-config for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
385: 	}
386: 
387: 	if resolvedStartupConfig != startupConfig {
388: 		nodeDefinition := config.Topology.Nodes[nodeName]
389: 		if nodeDefinition == nil {
390: 			nodeDefinition = &clabtypes.NodeDefinition{}
391: 			config.Topology.Nodes[nodeName] = nodeDefinition
392: 		}
393: 		nodeDefinition.StartupConfig = resolvedStartupConfig
394: 		*definitionChanged = true
395: 	}
396: 
397: 	for _, file := range files {
398: 		if err := stageLocalFile(configMaps, topologyName, nodeName, file); err != nil {
399: 			return err
400: 		}
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	return nil
404: }
405: 
406: func stageLicenseFile(
407: 	ctx context.Context,
408: 	config *clabRuntimeConfig,
409: 	topologyName,
410: 	nodeName,
411: 	topologyFileDir,
412: 	topologyLabDir string,
413: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
414: 	definitionChanged *bool,
415: ) error {
416: 	license := config.Topology.GetNodeLicense(nodeName)
417: 	if license == "" {
418: 		return nil
419: 	}
420: 
421: 	resolvedLicense, files, err := resolveNodeFileReference(
422: 		ctx, license, "license", nodeName, topologyFileDir, topologyLabDir,
423: 	)
424: 	if err != nil {
425: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed staging license for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
426: 	}
427: 	if resolvedLicense != license {
428: 		nodeDefinition := config.Topology.Nodes[nodeName]
429: 		if nodeDefinition == nil {
430: 			nodeDefinition = &clabtypes.NodeDefinition{}
431: 			config.Topology.Nodes[nodeName] = nodeDefinition
432: 		}
433: 		nodeDefinition.License = resolvedLicense
434: 		*definitionChanged = true
435: 	}
436: 	for _, file := range files {
437: 		if err := stageLocalFile(configMaps, topologyName, nodeName, file); err != nil {
438: 			return err
439: 		}
440: 	}
441: 
442: 	return nil
443: }
444: 
445: // resolveNodeFileReference uses the shared downloader for every supported URL scheme and
446: // preserves the filename (including .partial) that node implementations use to select formats.
447: func resolveNodeFileReference(
448: 	ctx context.Context,
449: 	sourcePath, field, nodeName, topologyFileDir, topologyLabDir string,
450: ) (string, []stagedLocalFile, error) {
451: 	sourcePath = filepath.ToSlash(replaceClabPathVariables(sourcePath, nodeName, topologyLabDir))
452: 	if strings.Contains(sourcePath, "\n") {
453: 		mountPath := filepath.Join("/clabernetes", nodeName, field, "embedded.lic")
454: 		return mountPath, []stagedLocalFile{{
455: 			filePath: mountPath, mode: fileModeRead, content: []byte(sourcePath),
456: 		}}, nil
457: 	}
458: 	if !clabutils.IsDownloadableURL(sourcePath) {
459: 		files, err := resolveLocalFiles(sourcePath, nodeName, topologyFileDir, topologyLabDir)
460: 		return sourcePath, files, err
461: 	}
462: 
463: 	file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "clab-c9s-download-*")
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		return "", nil, err
466: 	}
467: 	defer os.Remove(file.Name())
468: 	defer file.Close()
469: 	if err := clabutils.CopyFileContents(ctx, sourcePath, file); err != nil {
470: 		return "", nil, err
471: 	}
472: 	info, err := file.Stat()
473: 	if err != nil {
474: 		return "", nil, err
475: 	}
476: 	mountPath := filepath.Join("/clabernetes", nodeName, field,
477: 		filepath.Base(clabutils.FilenameForURL(ctx, sourcePath)))
478: 	staged, err := loadStagedLocalFile(mountPath, file.Name(), info)
479: 	if err != nil {
480: 		return "", nil, err
481: 	}
482: 
483: 	return mountPath, []stagedLocalFile{staged}, nil
484: }
485: 
486: func stageBindFiles(
487: 	config *clabRuntimeConfig,
488: 	topologyName,
489: 	nodeName,
490: 	topologyFileDir,
491: 	topologyLabDir string,
492: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
493: ) error {
494: 	binds, err := config.Topology.GetNodeBinds(nodeName)
495: 	if err != nil {
496: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed parsing bind mounts for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
497: 	}
498: 	if len(binds) == 0 {
499: 		return nil
500: 	}
501: 
502: 	for _, bind := range binds {
503: 		parsedBind, err := clabtypes.NewBindFromString(bind)
504: 		if err != nil {
505: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed parsing bind %q for node %q: %w", bind, nodeName, err)
506: 		}
507: 		if parsedBind.Src() == "" {
508: 			continue
509: 		}
510: 
511: 		if err := stageSourcePathIntoConfigMaps(
512: 			configMaps,
513: 			topologyName,
514: 			parsedBind.Src(),
515: 			nodeName,
516: 			topologyFileDir,
517: 			topologyLabDir,
518: 		); err != nil {
519: 			return err
520: 		}
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	return nil
524: }
525: 
526: // stageAdditionalNodeFiles covers path-bearing fields that containerlab normally resolves on
527: // the machine running the CLI. A device pod cannot see those paths unless the adapter copies
528: // them into the node's ConfigMap-backed file projection first.
529: func stageAdditionalNodeFiles(
530: 	config *clabRuntimeConfig,
531: 	topologyName,
532: 	nodeName,
533: 	topologyFileDir,
534: 	topologyLabDir string,
535: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
536: ) error {
537: 	pathsByField := map[string][]string{
538: 		"env-files": config.Topology.GetNodeEnvFiles(nodeName),
539: 	}
540: 
541: 	// kind-specific config key whose values are paths that a device pod cannot
542: 	// see unless they are staged into the node's ConfigMaps first.
543: 	pathFields := map[string]bool{
544: 		"copy-to-flash": true,
545: 	}
546: 
547: 	for _, entry := range config.Topology.GetNodeKindSpecificConfig(nodeName) {
548: 		if !pathFields[entry.Key] {
549: 			continue
550: 		}
551: 
552: 		paths, ok := entry.Value.([]any)
553: 		if !ok {
554: 			continue
555: 		}
556: 
557: 		pathsByField[entry.Key] = make([]string, 0, len(paths))
558: 		for _, p := range paths {
559: 			if s, ok := p.(string); ok {
560: 				pathsByField[entry.Key] = append(pathsByField[entry.Key], s)
561: 			}
562: 		}
563: 	}
564: 
565: 	fieldNames := make([]string, 0, len(pathsByField))
566: 	for fieldName := range pathsByField {
567: 		fieldNames = append(fieldNames, fieldName)
568: 	}
569: 	sort.Strings(fieldNames)
570: 
571: 	for _, fieldName := range fieldNames {
572: 		for _, sourcePath := range pathsByField[fieldName] {
573: 			if strings.TrimSpace(sourcePath) == "" {
574: 				continue
575: 			}
576: 
577: 			if err := stageSourcePathIntoConfigMaps(
578: 				configMaps,
579: 				topologyName,
580: 				sourcePath,
581: 				nodeName,
582: 				topologyFileDir,
583: 				topologyLabDir,
584: 			); err != nil {
585: 				return fmt.Errorf(
586: 					"failed staging %s path %q for node %q: %w",
587: 					fieldName,
588: 					sourcePath,
589: 					nodeName,
590: 					err,
591: 				)
592: 			}
593: 		}
594: 	}
595: 
596: 	return nil
597: }
598: 
599: func stageSourcePathIntoConfigMaps(
600: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
601: 	topologyName,
602: 	sourcePath,
603: 	nodeName,
604: 	topologyFileDir,
605: 	topologyLabDir string,
606: ) error {
607: 	files, err := resolveLocalFiles(sourcePath, nodeName, topologyFileDir, topologyLabDir)
608: 	if err != nil {
609: 		return fmt.Errorf(
610: 			"failed staging source path %q for node %q: %w",
611: 			sourcePath,
612: 			nodeName,
613: 			err,
614: 		)
615: 	}
616: 
617: 	for _, file := range files {
618: 		if err := stageLocalFile(configMaps, topologyName, nodeName, file); err != nil {
619: 			return err
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	return nil
624: }
625: 
626: func resolveLocalFiles(
627: 	sourcePath,
628: 	nodeName,
629: 	topologyFileDir,
630: 	topologyLabDir string,
631: ) ([]stagedLocalFile, error) {
632: 	displayPath := replaceClabPathVariables(sourcePath, nodeName, topologyLabDir)
633: 	resolvedPath := clabutils.ResolvePath(displayPath, topologyFileDir)
634: 
635: 	fileInfo, err := os.Stat(resolvedPath)
636: 	if err != nil {
637: 		return nil, err
638: 	}
639: 
640: 	if !fileInfo.IsDir() {
641: 		file, err := loadStagedLocalFile(displayPath, resolvedPath, fileInfo)
642: 		if err != nil {
643: 			return nil, err
644: 		}
645: 
646: 		return []stagedLocalFile{file}, nil
647: 	}
648: 
649: 	files := []stagedLocalFile{}
650: 	err = filepath.WalkDir(resolvedPath, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
651: 		if walkErr != nil {
652: 			return walkErr
653: 		}
654: 		if d.IsDir() {
655: 			return nil
656: 		}
657: 
658: 		fileInfo, err := d.Info()
659: 		if err != nil {
660: 			return err
661: 		}
662: 
663: 		relativePath, err := filepath.Rel(resolvedPath, path)
664: 		if err != nil {
665: 			return err
666: 		}
667: 
668: 		file, err := loadStagedLocalFile(
669: 			filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(displayPath, relativePath)),
670: 			path,
671: 			fileInfo,
672: 		)
673: 		if err != nil {
674: 			return err
675: 		}
676: 
677: 		files = append(files, file)
678: 
679: 		return nil
680: 	})
681: 	if err != nil {
682: 		return nil, err
683: 	}
684: 
685: 	sort.Slice(files, func(i, j int) bool {
686: 		return files[i].filePath < files[j].filePath
687: 	})
688: 
689: 	return files, nil
690: }
691: 
692: func loadStagedLocalFile(
693: 	filePath,
694: 	resolvedPath string,
695: 	fileInfo os.FileInfo,
696: ) (stagedLocalFile, error) {
697: 	content, err := os.ReadFile(resolvedPath) //nolint:gosec
698: 	if err != nil {
699: 		return stagedLocalFile{}, err
700: 	}
701: 	if len(content) > maxConfigMapFileBytes {
702: 		return stagedLocalFile{}, fmt.Errorf(
703: 			"file %q is %d bytes, larger than the supported ConfigMap file limit of %d bytes",
704: 			resolvedPath,
705: 			len(content),
706: 			maxConfigMapFileBytes,
707: 		)
708: 	}
709: 
710: 	mode := fileModeRead
711: 	if fileInfo.Mode()&0o111 != 0 {
712: 		mode = fileModeExecute
713: 	}
714: 
715: 	return stagedLocalFile{
716: 		filePath: filepath.ToSlash(filePath),
717: 		mode:     mode,
718: 		content:  content,
719: 	}, nil
720: }
721: 
722: func replaceClabPathVariables(sourcePath, nodeName, topologyLabDir string) string {
723: 	labName := filepath.Base(topologyLabDir)
724: 	nodeDir := ""
725: 	if topologyLabDir != "" && nodeName != "" {
726: 		nodeDir = filepath.Join(topologyLabDir, nodeName)
727: 	}
728: 
729: 	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
730: 		clabDirVar, topologyLabDir,
731: 		clabLabNameVar, labName,
732: 		nodeDirVar, nodeDir,
733: 		nodeNameVar, nodeName,
734: 	)
735: 
736: 	return replacer.Replace(sourcePath)
737: }
738: 
739: func stageLocalFile(
740: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
741: 	topologyName,
742: 	nodeName string,
743: 	file stagedLocalFile,
744: ) error {
745: 	return stageConfigMapFile(
746: 		configMaps,
747: 		topologyName,
748: 		file.filePath,
749: 		nodeName,
750: 		file.filePath,
751: 		file.mode,
752: 		file.content,
753: 	)
754: }
755: 
756: func stageConfigMapFile(
757: 	configMaps map[string]*stagedConfigMap,
758: 	topologyName,
759: 	identity,
760: 	nodeName,
761: 	filePath,
762: 	mode string,
763: 	content []byte,
764: ) error {
765: 	if len(content) > maxConfigMapFileBytes {
766: 		return fmt.Errorf(
767: 			"file %q is %d bytes, larger than the supported ConfigMap file limit of %d bytes",
768: 			filePath,
769: 			len(content),
770: 			maxConfigMapFileBytes,
771: 		)
772: 	}
773: 	identity = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(identity))
774: 	configMap, ok := configMaps[identity]
775: 	if ok {
776: 		if existing, _ := configMap.content("file"); !bytes.Equal(existing, content) {
777: 			return fmt.Errorf("staged file path %q has conflicting content", filePath)
778: 		}
779: 	} else {
780: 		configMap = &stagedConfigMap{

1113: func safeKubernetesName(parts ...string) string {
1114: 	name := strings.Join(parts, "-")
1115: 	if len(name) > kubernetesNameMaxLen {
1116: 		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(name))
1117: 		name = name[0:kubernetesNameMaxLen-8] + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])[0:7]
1118: 	}
1119: 
1120: 	name = strings.ToLower(name)
1121: 	name = invalidDNSLabelChars.ReplaceAllString(name, "-")
1122: 	name = startsWithNonAlpha.ReplaceAllString(name, "z")
1123: 	name = endsWithNonAlpha.ReplaceAllString(name, "z")
1124: 
1125: 	return name
1126: }

1: package names

3: import (

9: 	"strings"
10: )
11: 
12: const (
13: 	// kubernetesNameMaxLen is the maximum length of a DNS label, the form the object names a lab
14: 	// runtime derives from containerlab names have to take.
15: 	kubernetesNameMaxLen = 63
16: 	// nameDigestLen is the number of digest characters appended to a name that had to be
17: 	// truncated to fit kubernetesNameMaxLen.
18: 	nameDigestLen = 7
19: 	// leadingLetterPrefix prefixes a name that would otherwise start with a digit or a dash,
20: 	// which a DNS-1035 label cannot do.
21: 	leadingLetterPrefix = "clab-"
22: )
23: 
24: // nonKubernetesNameChars matches every run of characters a DNS label cannot carry, once the name
25: // has been lower-cased.
26: var nonKubernetesNameChars = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-z0-9-]+`)
27: 
28: // nonKubernetesLabelValueChars matches every run of characters a Kubernetes label value cannot
29: // carry. Label values keep the case the name was written with.
30: var nonKubernetesLabelValueChars = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+`)
31: 
32: // kubernetesLabelValue matches the label values the Kubernetes API server accepts. It mirrors
33: // apimachinery's IsValidLabelValue so the names package stays free of Kubernetes dependencies.
34: var kubernetesLabelValue = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9]([-a-zA-Z0-9_.]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?$`)
35: 
36: // SanitizeName maps a containerlab name onto the DNS-1035 label a lab runtime can name the objects
37: // it creates with: lower case, made up of a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter and at most 63
38: // characters long. A large share of public labs name their nodes R1/PE_1 or capitalize the lab
39: // name, and Kubernetes cannot carry those names as they are -- renaming them beats making the user
40: // edit every reference in the topology.
41: //
42: // The mapping is deterministic and idempotent: a name Kubernetes already accepts maps onto itself,
43: // so a sanitized name coming back from the runtime -- or typed by a user reading it off
44: // containerlab output -- resolves to the same object. The result is empty only for a name holding
45: // nothing a Kubernetes name can be built from.
46: func SanitizeName(name string) string {
47: 	sanitized := strings.Trim(
48: 		nonKubernetesNameChars.ReplaceAllString(strings.ToLower(name), "-"),
49: 		"-",
50: 	)
51: 	if sanitized == "" {
52: 		return ""
53: 	}
54: 
55: 	if sanitized[0] < 'a' || sanitized[0] > 'z' {
56: 		sanitized = leadingLetterPrefix + sanitized
57: 	}
58: 
59: 	if len(sanitized) > kubernetesNameMaxLen {
60: 		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(name))
61: 		sanitized = strings.TrimRight(
62: 			sanitized[:kubernetesNameMaxLen-nameDigestLen-1],
63: 			"-",
64: 		) + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])[:nameDigestLen]
65: 	}
66: 
67: 	return sanitized
68: }
69: 
70: // SanitizeNodeNames returns the sanitized name of every node name that needs one, keyed by the name
71: // the topology uses. Node names Kubernetes can carry as they are are absent from the result.
72: //
73: // Two node names that differ only in something Kubernetes cannot carry (R1 and r1) would collapse
74: // onto one object, so that is reported as an error instead of silently merging the two nodes.
75: func SanitizeNodeNames(nodeNames []string) (map[string]string, error) {
76: 	renames := map[string]string{}
77: 	origins := make(map[string]string, len(nodeNames))
78: 
79: 	sorted := slices.Clone(nodeNames)
80: 	slices.Sort(sorted)
81: 
82: 	for _, nodeName := range sorted {
83: 		sanitized := SanitizeName(nodeName)
84: 		if sanitized == "" {
85: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
86: 				"node name %q holds no character a Kubernetes object name can be built from",
87: 				nodeName,
88: 			)
89: 		}
90: 
91: 		if origin, taken := origins[sanitized]; taken {
92: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
93: 				"node names %q and %q both map onto the Kubernetes name %q; rename one of them",
94: 				origin,
95: 				nodeName,
96: 				sanitized,
97: 			)
98: 		}
99: 		origins[sanitized] = nodeName
100: 
101: 		if sanitized != nodeName {
102: 			renames[nodeName] = sanitized
103: 		}
104: 	}
105: 
106: 	return renames, nil
107: }
108: 
109: // SanitizeLabelValue maps a containerlab name onto the value of a Kubernetes label: at most 63
110: // characters, made up of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '-', '_' and '.', starting and ending with an alphanumeric
111: // character. Unlike SanitizeName it keeps the case the topology used, so a label selector matches
112: // the name the clab file spells out verbatim.
113: //
114: // The mapping is deterministic and idempotent: a name Kubernetes already accepts as a label value
115: // maps onto itself. The result is empty only for a name holding no character a label value can be
116: // built from.
117: func SanitizeLabelValue(name string) string {
118: 	if len(name) <= kubernetesNameMaxLen && kubernetesLabelValue.MatchString(name) {
119: 		return name
120: 	}
121: 
122: 	sanitized := strings.Trim(
123: 		nonKubernetesLabelValueChars.ReplaceAllString(name, "-"),
124: 		"-_.",
125: 	)
126: 	if sanitized == "" {
127: 		return ""
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if len(sanitized) > kubernetesNameMaxLen {
131: 		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(name))
132: 		sanitized = strings.TrimRight(
133: 			sanitized[:kubernetesNameMaxLen-nameDigestLen-1],
134: 			"-_.",
135: 		) + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])[:nameDigestLen]
136: 	}
137: 
138: 	return sanitized
139: }

The result is empty only for a name holding no character a label value can be\n// built from.\nfunc SanitizeLabelValue(name string) string {\n\tif len(name) <= kubernetesNameMaxLen && kubernetesLabelValue.MatchString(name) {\n\t\treturn name\n\t}\n\n\tsanitized := strings.Trim(\n\t\tnonKubernetesLabelValueChars.ReplaceAllString(name, \"-\"),\n\t\t\"-_.\",\n\t)\n\tif sanitized == \"\" {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\n\tif len(sanitized) > kubernetesNameMaxLen {\n\t\tdigest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(name))\n\t\tsanitized = strings.TrimRight(\n\t\t\tsanitized[:kubernetesNameMaxLen-nameDigestLen-1],\n\t\t\t\"-_.\",\n\t\t) + \"-\" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])[:nameDigestLen]\n\t}\n\n\treturn sanitized\n}",

314: +// clearInheritedLabRuntimeNodeFields prevents the inherited values from being merged a second

23: func (c *CLab) deployWithLabRuntime(
24: 	ctx context.Context,
25: 	options *DeployOptions,
26: ) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
27: 	if len(c.nodeFilter) != 0 {

29: 			c.globalRuntimeName)
30: 	}
31: 
32: 	if len(c.renderedTopology) == 0 {
33: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rendered topology is empty")
34: 	}
35: 
36: 	if options != nil && options.reconfigure {
37: 		// --reconfigure regenerates the lab from scratch, like removing a local lab
38: 		// directory, so it also deletes the persistent node storage.
39: 		err := c.LabRuntime.Destroy(ctx, clablabruntime.DestroyRequest{
40: 			Identity:   c.labRuntimeIdentity,

303: func (c *CLab) execWithLabRuntime(
304: 	ctx context.Context,
305: 	cmds []string,
306: 	listOptions ...ListOption,
307: ) (*clabexec.ExecCollection, error) {
308: 	containers, err := c.ListLabRuntimeContainers(ctx, false, listOptions...)
309: 	if err != nil {
310: 		return nil, err
311: 	}
312: 	if len(containers) == 0 {
313: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("filter did not match any containers")
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	var execCmds []*clabexec.ExecCmd
317: 	for _, execCmdStr := range cmds {
318: 		execCmd, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(execCmdStr)
319: 		if err != nil {
320: 			return nil, err
321: 		}
322: 		execCmds = append(execCmds, execCmd)
323: 	}
324: 
325: 	resultCollection := clabexec.NewExecCollection()
326: 	var execErrors []error
327: 	for idx := range containers {
328: 		namespace, labName, nodeName, err := labRuntimeContainerParts(containers[idx])
329: 		if err != nil {
330: 			log.Warnf("exec target %s is invalid: %v", containers[idx].Names[0], err)
331: 			execErrors = append(execErrors, fmt.Errorf(
332: 				"exec target %s is invalid: %w", containers[idx].Names[0], err))
333: 			continue
334: 		}
335: 
336: 		for _, execCmd := range execCmds {
337: 			result, err := c.LabRuntime.Exec(ctx, clablabruntime.ExecRequest{
338: 				Identity:  c.labRuntimeIdentity,
339: 				Name:      labName,
340: 				Namespace: namespace,
341: 				NodeName:  nodeName,
342: 				Command:   execCmd.GetCmd(),
343: 			})
344: 			if err != nil {
345: 				log.Warnf("exec on %s failed: %v", containers[idx].Names[0], err)
346: 				execErrors = append(execErrors, fmt.Errorf(
347: 					"exec on %s failed: %w", containers[idx].Names[0], err))
348: 				continue
349: 			}
350: 
351: 			resultCollection.Add(containers[idx].Names[0], result)
352: 			if result.GetReturnCode() != 0 {
353: 				execErrors = append(execErrors, fmt.Errorf(
354: 					"exec on %s returned exit code %d",
355: 					containers[idx].Names[0],
356: 					result.GetReturnCode(),
357: 				))
358: 			}
359: 		}
360: 	}
361: 
362: 	return resultCollection, errors.Join(execErrors...)
363: }

418: func (c *CLab) containersFromLabState(
419: 	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
420: ) []clabruntime.GenericContainer {
421: 	if state == nil {
422: 		return nil
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	nodes := state.Nodes
426: 	if len(nodes) == 0 && c.Config.Topology != nil {
427: 		nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(c.Config.Topology.Nodes))
428: 		for nodeName := range c.Config.Topology.Nodes {
429: 			nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
430: 		}
431: 		sort.Strings(nodeNames)
432: 
433: 		nodes = make([]clablabruntime.NodeState, 0, len(nodeNames))
434: 		for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
435: 			nodes = append(nodes, clablabruntime.NodeState{
436: 				Name:  nodeName,
437: 				Kind:  c.Config.Topology.GetNodeKind(nodeName),
438: 				Image: c.Config.Topology.GetNodeImage(nodeName),
439: 				State: state.State,
440: 				Ready: state.Ready,
441: 			})
442: 		}
443: 	}
444: 
445: 	containers := make([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, 0, len(nodes))
446: 	for _, node := range nodes {
447: 		containers = append(containers, c.containerFromLabNode(state, node))
448: 	}
449: 
450: 	return containers
451: }

462: func (c *CLab) containerFromLabNode(
463: 	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
464: 	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
465: ) clabruntime.GenericContainer {
466: 	nodeName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", state.Name, node.Name)
467: 	containerState, containerStatus := labRuntimeContainerState(state, node)
468: 
469: 	topologyNode := node.Name
470: 	if node.TopologyName != "" {
471: 		topologyNode = node.TopologyName
472: 	}
473: 	if c.Config.Topology != nil {
474: 		topologyNode = c.topologyNodeName(topologyNode)
475: 	}
476: 
477: 	labels := map[string]string{
478: 		clabconstants.Containerlab: state.Name,
479: 		clabconstants.NodeName:     topologyNode,
480: 		clabconstants.LongName:     nodeName,
481: 		clabconstants.TopoFile:     labRuntimeTopologyPath(c, state),
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	var image string
485: 	if c.Config.Topology != nil {
486: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeKind(topologyNode)
487: 		image = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeImage(topologyNode)
488: 	}
489: 	if node.Kind != "" {
490: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] = node.Kind
491: 	}
492: 	if node.Image != "" {
493: 		image = node.Image
494: 	}
495: 
496: 	// The node's type and group: from the loaded topology's node, with the kind's defaults the
497: 	// local runtimes report too, otherwise as the topology set them on the runtime's node.
498: 	nodeType, group := node.Type, node.Group
499: 	if topologyNodeConfig, ok := c.Nodes[topologyNode]; ok {
500: 		nodeType, group = topologyNodeConfig.Config().NodeType, topologyNodeConfig.Config().Group
501: 	} else if c.Config.Topology != nil && group == "" {
502: 		group = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeGroup(topologyNode)
503: 	}
504: 	if nodeType != "" {
505: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeType] = nodeType
506: 	}
507: 	if group != "" {
508: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeGroup] = group
509: 	}
510: 
511: 	if state.Owner != "" {
512: 		labels[clabconstants.Owner] = state.Owner
513: 	} else if c.customOwner != "" {
514: 		labels[clabconstants.Owner] = c.customOwner
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	// The ID names the node uniquely across namespaces and labs. It is also the short ID, so
518: 	// inspect reports it as container_id and it matches the events actor ID.
519: 	id := labRuntimeContainerID(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
520: 
521: 	return clabruntime.GenericContainer{
522: 		Names:           []string{nodeName},
523: 		ID:              id,
524: 		ShortID:         id,
525: 		Image:           image,
526: 		State:           containerState,
527: 		Status:          containerStatus,
528: 		Labels:          labels,
529: 		NetworkName:     state.Namespace,
530: 		NetworkSettings: managementAddress(node),
531: 		Ports:           labRuntimePorts(node.ExposedPorts),
532: 		Workload: &clabtypes.LabRuntimeWorkload{
533: 			Namespace:           state.Namespace,
534: 			Pod:                 node.Pod,
535: 			Container:           node.Container,
536: 			NodeUID:             node.NodeUID,
537: 			ExposedPorts:        node.ExposedPorts,
538: 			LoadBalancerAddress: node.LoadBalancerAddress,
539: 		},
540: 	}

543: // labRuntimeContainerState is a lab runtime node's state and status in the vocabulary of the
544: // container runtimes: state created, running or exited; status healthy or "health: starting"
545: // for a running node, as inspect shortens a Docker status line with a healthcheck, Created or
546: // Exited otherwise. A runtime that reports no container state keeps its own state.
547: func labRuntimeContainerState(
548: 	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
549: 	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
550: ) (string, string) {
551: 	switch node.ContainerState {
552: 	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning:
553: 		if node.Health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy {
554: 			return node.ContainerState, "healthy"
555: 		}
556: 
557: 		return node.ContainerState, "health: starting"
558: 	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated:
559: 		return node.ContainerState, "Created"
560: 	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited:
561: 		return node.ContainerState, "Exited"
562: 	}
563: 
564: 	if node.Ready {
565: 		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning, "healthy"
566: 	}
567: 	if node.State == "" {
568: 		return state.State, ""
569: 	}
570: 
571: 	return node.State, node.State
572: }
573: 
574: // labRuntimePorts reports the ports a lab runtime exposes for a node as the ports a container
575: // exposes without publishing them on the host: the node is reached through the runtime (a
576: // Service, a port-forward), never on a port of this machine.
577: func labRuntimePorts(ports []clablabruntime.ExposedPort) []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding {
578: 	if len(ports) == 0 {
579: 		return nil
580: 	}
581: 
582: 	bindings := make([]*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding, 0, len(ports))
583: 	for _, port := range ports {
584: 		bindings = append(bindings, &clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{
585: 			ContainerPort: port.Port,
586: 			Protocol:      port.Protocol,
587: 		})
588: 	}
589: 
590: 	return bindings
591: }

593: // labRuntimeContainerID is the ID of a lab runtime node: <namespace>/<lab>/<node>.
594: func labRuntimeContainerID(namespace, lab, node string) string {
595: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s", namespace, lab, node)
596: }
597: 
598: // topologyNodeName maps a node name a lab runtime reports back onto the topology node it belongs
599: // to. The runtime renames the nodes Kubernetes cannot carry, so the state it reports does not
600: // always use the name the topology file wrote.
601: func (c *CLab) topologyNodeName(name string) string {
602: 	if c.Config.Topology == nil {
603: 		return name
604: 	}
605: 	if _, ok := c.Config.Topology.Nodes[name]; ok {
606: 		return name
607: 	}
608: 
609: 	for nodeName := range c.Config.Topology.Nodes {
610: 		if clabnames.SanitizeName(nodeName) == name {
611: 			return nodeName
612: 		}
613: 	}
614: 
615: 	return name
616: }

618: // managementAddress reports the address a user reaches the node at: the LoadBalancer address
619: // when the node is exposed, otherwise the allocated management address.
620: func managementAddress(node clablabruntime.NodeState) clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs {
621: 	settings := clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs{}
622: 
623: 	if ip := net.ParseIP(node.LoadBalancerAddress); ip != nil {
624: 		if ip.To4() != nil {
625: 			settings.IPv4addr = node.LoadBalancerAddress
626: 			settings.IPv4pLen = 32
627: 		} else {
628: 			settings.IPv6addr = node.LoadBalancerAddress
629: 			settings.IPv6pLen = 128
630: 		}
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	if settings.IPv4addr == "" {
634: 		settings.IPv4addr, settings.IPv4pLen = splitManagementCIDR(node.MgmtIPv4Address)
635: 	}
636: 	if settings.IPv6addr == "" {
637: 		settings.IPv6addr, settings.IPv6pLen = splitManagementCIDR(node.MgmtIPv6Address)
638: 	}
639: 
640: 	return settings
641: }
642: 
643: func splitManagementCIDR(cidr string) (string, int) {
644: 	if cidr == "" {
645: 		return "", 0
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	ip, network, err := net.ParseCIDR(cidr)
649: 	if err != nil {
650: 		if net.ParseIP(cidr) != nil {
651: 			return cidr, 0
652: 		}
653: 
654: 		return "", 0
655: 	}
656: 
657: 	prefixLen, _ := network.Mask.Size()
658: 
659: 	return ip.String(), prefixLen
660: }

662: func labRuntimeTopologyPath(c *CLab, state *clablabruntime.LabState) string {
663: 	if c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileIsSet() {
664: 		return c.TopoPaths.TopologyFilenameAbsPath()
665: 	}
666: 
667: 	if state.TopologyPath != "" {
668: 		return state.TopologyPath
669: 	}
670: 
671: 	return fmt.Sprintf("k8s://%s/topologies/%s", state.Namespace, state.Name)
672: }

674: func labRuntimeContainerParts(c clabruntime.GenericContainer) (string, string, string, error) {
675: 	parts := strings.Split(c.ID, "/")
676: 	if len(parts) != 3 {
677: 		return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("expected namespace/lab/node id, got %q", c.ID)
678: 	}
679: 
680: 	return parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], nil
681: }

683: func filterLabRuntimeContainers(
684: 	containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,
685: 	filters []*clabtypes.GenericFilter,
686: ) []clabruntime.GenericContainer {
687: 	if len(filters) == 0 {
688: 		return containers
689: 	}
690: 
691: 	filtered := make([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, 0, len(containers))
692: 	for _, container := range containers {
693: 		if labRuntimeContainerMatches(container, filters) {
694: 			filtered = append(filtered, container)
695: 		}
696: 	}
697: 
698: 	return filtered
699: }
700: 
701: func labRuntimeContainerMatches(
702: 	container clabruntime.GenericContainer,
703: 	filters []*clabtypes.GenericFilter,
704: ) bool {
705: 	for _, filter := range filters {
706: 		switch filter.FilterType {
707: 		case "name":
708: 			if !labRuntimeNameMatches(container.Names, filter.Match) {
709: 				return false
710: 			}
711: 		case "id":
712: 			if container.ID != filter.Match && !strings.HasPrefix(container.ID, filter.Match) {
713: 				return false
714: 			}
715: 		case "label":
716: 			if !labRuntimeLabelMatches(container.Labels, filter) {
717: 				return false
718: 			}
719: 		}
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	return true
723: }
724: 
725: func labRuntimeNameMatches(names []string, match string) bool {
726: 	for _, name := range names {
727: 		if name == match || strings.Contains(name, match) {
728: 			return true
729: 		}
730: 	}
731: 
732: 	return false
733: }
734: 
735: func labRuntimeLabelMatches(labels map[string]string, filter *clabtypes.GenericFilter) bool {
736: 	value, ok := labels[filter.Field]
737: 
738: 	switch filter.Operator {
739: 	case "exists":
740: 		return ok
741: 	case "!=":
742: 		return !ok || value != filter.Match
743: 	default:
744: 		return ok && value == filter.Match
745: 	}
746: }

748: func (c *CLab) copyLabRuntimeSavedFiles(
749: 	result *clablabruntime.SaveResult,
750: 	dstRoot string,
751: ) error {
752: 	for _, file := range result.Files {
753: 		if file.NodeName == "" || file.Name == "" {
754: 			continue
755: 		}
756: 
757: 		relPath, ok := cleanLabRuntimeSavedPath(file.Name)
758: 		if !ok {
759: 			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to copy unsafe saved config path %q", file.Name)
760: 		}
761: 
762: 		nodeDstDir := filepath.Join(dstRoot, file.NodeName)
763: 		dstPath := filepath.Join(nodeDstDir, relPath)
764: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(
765: 			filepath.Dir(dstPath),
766: 			clabconstants.PermissionsDirDefault,
767: 		); err != nil {
768: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create save dst directory %q: %w",
769: 				filepath.Dir(dstPath), err)
770: 		}
771: 
772: 		if file.LinkTarget != "" {
773: 			linkTarget, ok := cleanLabRuntimeSavedLinkTarget(file.LinkTarget)
774: 			if !ok {
775: 				return fmt.Errorf("refusing to create unsafe saved config symlink %q -> %q",
776: 					file.Name, file.LinkTarget)
777: 			}
778: 
779: 			_ = os.Remove(dstPath)
780: 			if err := os.Symlink(linkTarget, dstPath); err != nil {
781: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed to create symlink %q -> %q: %w",
782: 					dstPath, linkTarget, err)
783: 			}
784: 
785: 			continue
786: 		}
787: 
788: 		mode := os.FileMode(file.Mode)
789: 		if mode == 0 {
790: 			mode = clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault
791: 		}
792: 
793: 		if err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, file.Data, mode); err != nil {
794: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write saved config %q: %w", dstPath, err)
795: 		}
796: 
797: 		log.Info(
798: 			"copied saved config",
799: 			"node", file.NodeName,
800: 			"dst", dstPath,
801: 		)
802: 	}
803: 
804: 	return nil
805: }
806: 
807: func cleanLabRuntimeSavedPath(name string) (string, bool) {
808: 	cleaned := filepath.Clean(name)
809: 	if cleaned == "." || filepath.IsAbs(cleaned) ||
810: 		strings.HasPrefix(cleaned, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) ||
811: 		cleaned == ".." {
812: 		return "", false
813: 	}
814: 
815: 	return cleaned, true
816: }
817: 
818: func cleanLabRuntimeSavedLinkTarget(target string) (string, bool) {
819: 	cleaned := filepath.Clean(target)
820: 	if filepath.IsAbs(cleaned) ||
821: 		strings.HasPrefix(cleaned, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) ||
822: 		cleaned == ".." {
823: 		return "", false
824: 	}
825: 
826: 	return cleaned, true
827: }

c.timeout,\n\t\t\tMaxWorkers: options.maxWorkers,\n\t\t\tCleanup:    true,\n\t\t})\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treq, err := c.labRuntimeDeployRequest()\n\tif err != nil topologyFile,\n\t\tTopologyLabDir:     topologyLabDir,\n\t\tTopologyDefinition: c.renderedTopology,\n\t\tTimeout:            c.timeout,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// applyLabRuntimeDeployOptions copies the options)\n\n\treturn emitter.Manifests(ctx, req)\n}\n\n// ValidateLabRuntimeTopology executes the selected runtime's compiler without mutation.\nfunc (c *CLab) ValidateLabRuntimeTopology(ctx {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn validator.Validate(ctx, req)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) destroyWithLabRuntime(ctx context.Context, opts *DestroyOptions) error {\n\tif len(opts.nodeFilter) != 0 c.destroyAllWithLabRuntime(ctx, opts)\n\t}\n\n\tif c.Config.Name == \"\" {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"topology name is required\")\n\t}\n\n\terr := c.LabRuntime.Destroy(ctx, clablabruntime.DestroyRequest{\n\t\tIdentity:   c.labRuntimeIdentity,\n\t\tName:       c.Config.Name,\n\t\tWait:       true,\n\t\tTimeout:    c.timeout,\n\t\tMaxWorkers: opts.maxWorkers,\n\t\tCleanup:    opts.cleanup,\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif opts.cleanup {\n\t\treturn c.cleanupLabRuntimeLabDir()\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// cleanupLabRuntimeLabDir removes the local Controller-driven runtimes keep node state remotely, so the directory usually only\n// exists when a lab was previously deployed locally or configs were copied out.\nfunc (c *CLab) nil\n\t}\n\tif _, err := os.Stat(labDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\"Removing lab directory\", \"path\", labDir)\n\n\tif err := os.RemoveAll(labDir); err != nil {\n\tstates, err := c.LabRuntime.List(ctx, clablabruntime.ListRequest{\n\t\tAllNamespaces: true,\n\t\tIdentity:      c.labRuntimeIdentity,\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif len(states) == 0 {\n\t\tlog.Info(\"no clabernetes topologies found\")\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\ttopos := make(map[string]string, len(states))\n\tfor _, state := range states {\n\t\ttopos[state.TopologyPath] = \"\"\n\t}\n\n\tif opts.terminalPrompt && term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) {\n\t\tif err := cliPromptToDestroyAll(topos); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tvar errs []error\n\tfor _, state := range states {\n\t\tif err := c.LabRuntime.Destroy(ctx, clablabruntime.DestroyRequest{\n\t\t\tIdentity:   c.labRuntimeIdentity,\n\t\t\tName:       state.Name,\n\t\t\tNamespace:  state.Namespace,\n\t\t\tWait:       true,\n\t\t\tTimeout:    c.timeout,\n\t\t\tMaxWorkers: opts.maxWorkers,\n\t\t\tCleanup:    opts.cleanup,\n\t\t}); err != nil %w\",\n\t\t\terrors.Join(errs...))\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) ListLabRuntimeContainers(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tall bool,\n\toptions ...ListOption,\n) []*clabexec.ExecCmd\n\tfor _, execCmdStr := range cmds {\n\t\texecCmd, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(execCmdStr)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\texecCmds = append(execCmds, execCmd)\n\t}\n\n\tresultCollection := clabexec.NewExecCollection()\n\tvar execErrors []error\n\tfor idx := range containers {\n\t\tnamespace, labName, nodeName, err := clablabruntime.ExecRequest{\n\t\t\t\tIdentity:  c.labRuntimeIdentity,\n\t\t\t\tName:      labName,\n\t\t\t\tNamespace: namespace,\n\t\t\t\tNodeName:  nodeName,\n\t\t\t\tCommand: on %s failed: %w\", containers[idx].Names[0], err))\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tresultCollection.Add(containers[idx].Names[0], result)\n\t\t\tif result.GetReturnCode() != 0 %d\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcontainers[idx].Names[0],\n\t\t\t\t\tresult.GetReturnCode(),\n\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn resultCollection, errors.Join(execErrors...)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) c.Config.Name,\n\t\tNodes:    nodeNames,\n\t\tTimeout:  c.timeout,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) saveWithLabRuntime(ctx context.Context, opts *SaveOptions) error {\n\tif opts.copyDst != \"\" err\n\t}\n\n\tif opts.copyDst == \"\" || result == nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn c.copyLabRuntimeSavedFiles(result, opts.copyDst)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) containersFromLabState(\n\tstate *clablabruntime.LabState,\n) []clabruntime.GenericContainer {\n\tif state == nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tnodes := state.Nodes\n\tif len(nodes) == 0 && c.Config.Topology != nil {\n\t\tnodeNames := LabRuntimeContainer describes a lab runtime node as a container record, the way inspect\n// reports it. The events command describes lab runtime nodes with it too.\nfunc (c *CLab) LabRuntimeContainer(\n\tstate *clablabruntime.LabState,\n\tnode clablabruntime.NodeState,\n) clabruntime.GenericContainer {\n\treturn c.containerFromLabNode(state, node)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) containerFromLabNode(\n\tstate *clablabruntime.LabState,\n\tnode clablabruntime.NodeState,\n) clabruntime.GenericContainer {\n\tnodeName := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%s\", state.Name, node.Name)\n\tcontainerState, containerStatus := labRuntimeContainerState(state, node)\n\n\ttopologyNode := node.Name\n\tif node.TopologyName != \"\" {\n\t\ttopologyNode = node.TopologyName\n\t}\n\tif c.Config.Topology != nil {\n\t\ttopologyNode = c.topologyNodeName(topologyNode)\n\t}\n\n\tlabels := map[string]string{\n\t\tclabconstants.Containerlab: state.Name,\n\t\tclabconstants.NodeName:     topologyNode,\n\t\tclabconstants.LongName:     nodeName,\n\t\tclabconstants.TopoFile:     labRuntimeTopologyPath(c, state),\n\t}\n\n\tvar image string\n\tif c.Config.Topology != nil {\n\t\tlabels[clabconstants.NodeKind] = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeKind(topologyNode)\n\t\timage = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeImage(topologyNode)\n\t}\n\tif node.Kind != \"\" {\n\t\tlabels[clabconstants.NodeKind] = node.Kind\n\t}\n\tif node.Image != \"\" {\n\t\timage = node.Image\n\t}\n\n\t// The node's type and group: from the loaded topology's node, with the kind's defaults the\n\t// local runtimes report too, otherwise as the topology set them on the runtime's node.\n\tnodeType, group := node.Type, node.Group\n\tif topologyNodeConfig, ok := c.Nodes[topologyNode]; ok {\n\t\tnodeType, group = topologyNodeConfig.Config().NodeType, topologyNodeConfig.Config().Group\n\t} else if c.Config.Topology != nil && group == \"\" {\n\t\tgroup = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeGroup(topologyNode)\n\t}\n\tif nodeType != \"\" {\n\t\tlabels[clabconstants.NodeType] = nodeType\n\t}\n\tif group != \"\" {\n\t\tlabels[clabconstants.NodeGroup] = group\n\t}\n\n\tif state.Owner != \"\" {\n\t\tlabels[clabconstants.Owner] = state.Owner\n\t} else if c.customOwner != \"\" {\n\t\tlabels[clabconstants.Owner] = c.customOwner\n\t}\n\n\t// The ID names the node uniquely across namespaces and labs. It is also the short ID, so\n\t// inspect reports it as container_id and it matches the events actor ID.\n\tid := labRuntimeContainerID(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)\n\n\treturn clabruntime.GenericContainer{\n\t\tNames:           []string{nodeName},\n\t\tID:              id,\n\t\tShortID:         id,\n\t\tImage:           image,\n\t\tState:           containerState,\n\t\tStatus:          containerStatus,\n\t\tLabels:          labels,\n\t\tNetworkName:     state.Namespace,\n\t\tNetworkSettings: managementAddress(node),\n\t\tPorts:           labRuntimePorts(node.ExposedPorts),\n\t\tWorkload: &clabtypes.LabRuntimeWorkload{\n\t\t\tNamespace:           state.Namespace,\n\t\t\tPod:                 node.Pod,\n\t\t\tContainer:           node.Container,\n\t\t\tNodeUID:             node.NodeUID,\n\t\t\tExposedPorts:        node.ExposedPorts,\n\t\t\tLoadBalancerAddress: node.LoadBalancerAddress,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// labRuntimeContainerState is a lab runtime node's state and status in the vocabulary of the\n// container runtimes: state created, running or exited; status healthy or \"health: starting\"\n// for a running node, as inspect shortens a Docker status line with a healthcheck, Created or\n// Exited otherwise. A runtime that reports no container state keeps its own state.\nfunc labRuntimeContainerState(\n\tstate *clablabruntime.LabState,\n\tnode clablabruntime.NodeState,\n) (string, string) {\n\tswitch node.ContainerState {\n\tcase clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning:\n\t\tif node.Health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy {\n\t\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"healthy\"\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"health: starting\"\n\tcase clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated:\n\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"Created\"\n\tcase clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited:\n\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"Exited\"\n\t}\n\n\tif node.Ready {\n\t\treturn clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning, \"healthy\"\n\t}\n\tif node.State == \"\" {\n\t\treturn state.State, \"\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn node.State, node.State\n}\n\n// labRuntimePorts reports the ports a lab runtime exposes for a node as the ports a container\n// exposes without publishing them on the host: the node is reached through the runtime (a\n// Service, a port-forward), never on a port of this machine.\nfunc labRuntimePorts(ports []clablabruntime.ExposedPort) []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding {\n\tif len(ports) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tbindings := make([]*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding, 0, len(ports))\n\tfor _, port := range ports {\n\t\tbindings = append(bindings, &clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{\n\t\t\tContainerPort: port.Port,\n\t\t\tProtocol:      port.Protocol,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\treturn bindings\n}\n\n// labRuntimeContainerID is the ID of a lab runtime node: <namespace>/<lab>/<node>.\nfunc labRuntimeContainerID(namespace, lab, node string) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%s/%s\", namespace, lab, node)\n}\n\n// topologyNodeName maps a node name a lab runtime reports back onto the topology node it belongs\n// to. The runtime renames the nodes Kubernetes cannot carry, so the state it reports does not\n// always use the name the topology file wrote.\nfunc (c *CLab) topologyNodeName(name string) string {\n\tif c.Config.Topology == nil {\n\t\treturn name\n\t}\n\tif _, ok := c.Config.Topology.Nodes[name]; ok {\n\t\treturn name\n\t}\n\n\tfor nodeName := range c.Config.Topology.Nodes {\n\t\tif clabnames.SanitizeName(nodeName) == name {\n\t\t\treturn nodeName\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn name\n}\n\n// managementAddress reports the address a user reaches the node at: the LoadBalancer address\n// when the node is exposed, otherwise the allocated management address.\nfunc managementAddress(node clablabruntime.NodeState) clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs {\n\tsettings := clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs{}\n\n\tif ip := net.ParseIP(node.LoadBalancerAddress); ip != nil {\n\t\tif ip.To4() != nil {\n\t\t\tsettings.IPv4addr = node.LoadBalancerAddress\n\t\t\tsettings.IPv4pLen = 32\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tsettings.IPv6addr = node.LoadBalancerAddress\n\t\t\tsettings.IPv6pLen = 128\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif settings.IPv4addr == \"\" {\n\t\tsettings.IPv4addr, settings.IPv4pLen = splitManagementCIDR(node.MgmtIPv4Address)\n\t}\n\tif settings.IPv6addr == \"\" {\n\t\tsettings.IPv6addr, settings.IPv6pLen = splitManagementCIDR(node.MgmtIPv6Address)\n\t}\n\n\treturn settings\n}\n\nfunc splitManagementCIDR(cidr string) (string, int) {\n\tif cidr == \"\" {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0\n\t}\n\n\tip, network, err := net.ParseCIDR(cidr)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif net.ParseIP(cidr) != nil {\n\t\t\treturn cidr, 0\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn \"\", 0\n\t}\n\n\tprefixLen, _ := network.Mask.Size()\n\n\treturn ip.String(), prefixLen\n}\n\nfunc labRuntimeTopologyPath(c *CLab, state *clablabruntime.LabState) string {\n\tif c.TopoPaths.TopologyFileIsSet() {\n\t\treturn c.TopoPaths.TopologyFilenameAbsPath()\n\t}\n\n\tif state.TopologyPath != \"\" {\n\t\treturn state.TopologyPath\n\t}\n\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"k8s://%s/topologies/%s\", state.Namespace, state.Name)\n}\n\nfunc labRuntimeContainerParts(c clabruntime.GenericContainer) (string, string, string, error) {\n\tparts := strings.Split(c.ID, \"/\")\n\tif len(parts) != 3 {\n\t\treturn \"\", \"\", \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"expected namespace/lab/node id, got %q\", c.ID)\n\t}\n\n\treturn parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], nil\n}\n\nfunc filterLabRuntimeContainers(\n\tcontainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,\n\tfilters []*clabtypes.GenericFilter,\n) []clabruntime.GenericContainer {\n\tif len(filters) == 0 {\n\t\treturn containers\n\t}\n\n\tfiltered := make([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, 0, len(containers))\n\tfor _, container := range containers {\n\t\tif labRuntimeContainerMatches(container, filters) {\n\t\t\tfiltered = append(filtered, container)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn filtered\n}\n\nfunc labRuntimeContainerMatches(\n\tcontainer clabruntime.GenericContainer,\n\tfilters 860: // ProcessDownloadableAndEmbeddedFile materializes embedded content or supported download URLs and
861: // returns a local path. Local file references are returned unchanged.
862: func ProcessDownloadableAndEmbeddedFile(
863: 	ctx context.Context,
864: 	nodeName,
865: 	fileRef,
866: 	filenamePostfix string,
867: 	paths DownloadFilesInterface,
868: ) (string, error) {
869: 	isEmbeddedFile := strings.Count(fileRef, "\n") >= 1
870: 	isDownloadableFile := IsDownloadableURL(fileRef)
871: 
872: 	if !isEmbeddedFile && !isDownloadableFile {
873: 		return fileRef, nil
874: 	}
875: 
876: 	CreateDirectory(paths.ClabTmpDir(), clabconstants.PermissionsDirDefault)
877: 
878: 	switch {
879: 	case isEmbeddedFile:
880: 		log.Debugf("%q of node %q is an embedded blob", fileRef, nodeName)
881: 
882: 		dstFileAbsPath := paths.DownloadFileTmpAbsPath(nodeName, filenamePostfix)
883: 		if err := CreateFile(dstFileAbsPath, fileRef); err != nil {
884: 			return "", err
885: 		}
886: 
887: 		return dstFileAbsPath, nil
888: 
889: 	case isDownloadableFile:
890: 		fname := FilenameForURL(ctx, fileRef)
891: 		dstFileAbsPath := paths.DownloadFileTmpAbsPath(nodeName, fname)
892: 
893: 		log.Debugf("Fetching %q for node %q storing at %q", fileRef, nodeName, dstFileAbsPath)
894: 
895: 		out, cleanup, err := CreateFileWithPermissions(
896: 			dstFileAbsPath,
897: 			clabconstants.PermissionsDirDefault,
898: 		)
899: 		if err != nil {
900: 			return "", err
901: 		}
902: 		defer cleanup()
903: 
904: 		if err := CopyFileContents(ctx, fileRef, out); err != nil {
905: 			return "", err
906: 		}
907: 
908: 		return dstFileAbsPath, nil
909: 	}
910: 
911: 	return fileRef, nil
912: }

  Line 81: Containerlab's Go API gained lab-runtime interfaces for locating nodes, opening interactive terminals, streaming logs, forwarding TCP ports, sampling CPU and memory usage, and capturing packets. /source/head/docs/cmd/deploy.md:
  Line 261: `c9s` is a lab runtime, not a per-node container runtime. When it is selected, containerlab renders the topology and creates a Clabernetes `Topology` custom resource. See [Containerlab runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md) for details.

  Line 347: The `--no-topology-cr` flag applies to the [clabernetes runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md) only. By default, deploy persists the rendered topology as a c9s `Topology` resource and the Clabernetes manager compiles it into the `Node`, `Link`, and `NodeProfile` resources. With this flag, containerlab skips the `Topology` resource and compiles the topology client-side, creating and reconciling those resources directly.

  Line 355: The `--emit-crs` flag applies to the [clabernetes runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md) only. Instead of applying anything, deploy prints the Kubernetes manifests it would create to stdout as a multi-document YAML stream, so they can be saved, edited by hand, and applied with `kubectl`. The cluster is not contacted.

  Line 371: The `--image-pull-secret` flag applies to the [clabernetes runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md) only. It sets the name of the image pull secret populated in the c9s `Topology` CR (`spec.imagePull.pullSecrets`), which the kubelet uses when pulling node images. The secret must exist in the lab namespace.

  Line 382: [clabernetes runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md) only. It sets

By default, deploy enables persistence on the c9s `Topology` CR (`spec.deployment.persistence.enabled`), backing every node's artifact volume with a PersistentVolumeClaim so saved device configuration survives pod replacement -- the same contract the lab directory provides with local runtimes. Reasoning
This confirms the c9s side handles links robustly: `clabernetesBriefLinks` converts any parsed `LinkDefinition` (brief, veth, host, mgmt-net, macvlan) into `LinkBriefRaw`. The comment at line 137-139: "Always render parsed links through the c9s brief-link boundary so an extended link's behavior does not depend on whether some unrelated field changed the definition."

So the new unmarshal→marshal round-trip of links in the expanded definition is safe: c9s re-parses the definition into `clabRuntimeConfig` with `Topology *clabtypes.Topology` (LinkDefinition with full unmarshal) and then converts to brief for the CR. One question: does `LinkDefinition.MarshalYAML` handle ALL link types? Let me see the rest of `MarshalYAML` (lines 291-360 of link.go) — there was a `default` case? If a link type (e.g., vxlan, dummy, bridge) is present, the definition re-marshal could fail. Let me check: `LinkTypeVxlan`, `LinkTypeVxlanStitch`, `LinkTypeDummy`, `LinkTypeBridge`, `LinkTypeMacVLan` handling in `MarshalYAML`.

But note: before this PR, the raw bytes were sent verbatim, so a vxlan link in the file stayed as `type: vxlan...`; c9s parsed it as LinkBriefRaw? Hmm — wait, c9s's `clabRuntimeConfig.Topology` is `*clabtypes.Topology` with `Links []*clablinks.LinkDefinition` — full unmarshal. So pre-PR, c9s ALSO unmarshaled the definition with the full `LinkDefinition.UnmarshalYAML`, converting brief → typed. So pre-PR, the definition yaml for a vxlan link parses fine (UnmarshalYAML handles vxlan) and `clabernetesBriefLink` errors for unsupported types ("failed to render clabernetes-compatible brief link").

Post-PR, the flow in containerlab itself ALSO unmarshals (in the new expansion) and RE-MARSHALS via `LinkDefinition.MarshalYAML`. If `MarshalYAML` errors on some type (e.g., bridge — is LinkTypeBridge in parseLinkType? No! parseLinkType doesn't handle "bridge"... it handles macvlan, veth, veth-stitch, mgmt-net, host, brief, vxlan, vxlan-stitch, dummy. Bridge is a LinkType const but not parseable? Interesting — maybe bridge links can only be produced programmatically, or maybe handled elsewhere).

So the risk: a topology with a link type that `UnmarshalYAML` accepts but `MarshalYAML` errors on (or marshals incorrectly) would now fail at `prepareLabRuntimeTopology` with a marshal error, where pre-PR it worked. Let me read the rest of MarshalYAML to see all cases and the default.

Reasoning
So `MarshalYAML` case LinkTypeHost emits:

```yaml
type: veth
host-interface: <if>
endpoint: {node: r1, interface: eth1}
```

Wait no — it emits `LinkHostRaw` inline with `Type: string(LinkTypeVEth)`. So the marshaled yaml is:

```yaml
- type: veth
  host-interface: eth1
  endpoint:
    node: r1
    interface: eth1
```

Re-parsing this: `UnmarshalYAML` reads `type: veth` → LinkTypeVEth → unmarshal into `LinkVEthRaw` — which has `Endpoints []*EndpointRaw` — but the yaml has `host-interface` and `endpoint` fields, which are NOT fields of `LinkVEthRaw`. Under strict parsing, unknown fields → error. Under non-strict (the new code uses plain `yaml.Unmarshal` into `&Config{}` — NOT strict!), unknown fields are IGNORED. So a host link re-marshaled as `type: veth` with `host-interface`/`endpoint` keys would re-parse as a veth link with NO endpoints!

Hmm wait — but that's about the SECOND parse. The flow: `c.renderedTopology` (raw file) → unmarshal into `source`/`expanded` (LinkDefinition with LinkHostRaw) → expand → marshal (host link becomes `type: veth` + host-interface + endpoint) → `c.renderedTopology` = new bytes. Then `labRuntimeDeployRequest` sends those bytes to c9s, which parses into `clabRuntimeConfig` → `Topology *clabtypes.Topology` → `LinkDefinition.UnmarshalYAML` → `type: veth` → LinkVEthRaw unmarshal → `host-interface` and `endpoint` keys are NOT LinkVEthRaw fields → ignored (non-strict yaml.Unmarshal) → link with ZERO endpoints!

Then `clabernetesBriefLinks` → for the veth link with no endpoints → `ToLinkBriefRaw` produces `Endpoints: []` — brief link with empty endpoints → the controller's link compilation fails or produces garbage.

Compare pre-PR: the definition had the raw brief form `- endpoints: [host:eth1, r1:eth1]` → c9s parses into LinkDefinition → brief → hostLinkFromBrief → works.

So this is a REAL REGRESSION for host brief links with the c9s runtime!

Wait, wait. Let me be careful. `MarshalYAML` case LinkTypeHost sets `Type: string(LinkTypeVEth)` — is that a bug in the pre-existing code, or intentional? The comment says "As of now it falls back to converting the LinkConfig into a RawVEthLink, such that the generated LinkConfigs adhere to the new LinkDefinition format instead of the brief one." This marshaler was written for `clab generate` output. Let me check how `clab generate` uses it — in `generate` command, `LinkDefinition` built with `Link: &LinkHostRaw{}`? And the output yaml `type: veth` with `host-interface`... that would be WRONG for re-deploy too. Hmm, let me check git history/tests for `MarshalYAML` host case. Actually let me check the test for it: links/link_test.go maybe tests marshal of host links. Let me grep for `MarshalYAML` usage/tests of LinkDefinition.

So even the FIRST parse (into `source`) materializes `mtu: 9500` on every brief link. Post-PR re-marshal writes `mtu: 9500` explicitly. Also — wait, this matters for another reason: the c9s parse (`clabRuntimeConfig` unmarshal, non-strict) ALSO materializes MTU on brief links (via UnmarshalYAML). So pre-PR, the CR's links already carried materialized MTU (through `ToLinkBriefRaw` which copies LinkCommonParams incl. MTU). So MTU materialization is not new. OK.

Now the HOST link re-marshal question. `MarshalYAML` case LinkTypeHost emits `Type: string(LinkTypeVEth)` with `LinkHostRaw` inline. Let me see what the serialized yaml looks like:

```yaml
type: veth
host-interface: srl1_e1-5
endpoint:
  node: srl1
  interface: e1-5
```

Hmm — wait, actually. Is `Type` the last field? Struct order: `LinkHostRaw` inline first, `Type` second → field order in output: `host-interface`, `endpoint`, then `type: veth` at the END (yaml.v2 marshals in struct field order, and inline structs' fields come first). So the output is:

```yaml
host-interface: srl1_e1-5
endpoint:
  node: r1
  interface: eth1
type: veth
```

And when `types.Topology` re-marshals `Links []*LinkDefinition`, each item goes through `LinkDefinition.MarshalYAML` → this struct.

Now — the re-parse (c9s `clabRuntimeConfig`, non-strict): `LinkDefinition.UnmarshalYAML` reads `type` → "veth" → LinkTypeVEth → unmarshal into struct{Type, LinkVEthRaw inline}. `LinkVEthRaw` has `LinkCommonParams` inline + `Endpoints`. The keys `host-interface` and `endpoint` are not in LinkVEthRaw → with plain `yaml.Unmarshal` (non-strict) → IGNORED. Endpoints empty → a veth link with NO endpoints.

Then `clabernetesBriefLink` → `raw.ToLinkBriefRaw()` → `Endpoints: []` brief link. `renameBriefLinkEndpoints` — no-op. The CR then has a link with empty endpoints → the clabernetes controller fails to compile it or drops it → **the host link silently disappears from the deployed lab**.

What if the file has `topology:` with a NULL value? `source.Topology` nil → early return, keep original. Good.

**Finding 1 (P2): Host links are corrupted by the new re-marshal.**

- Trigger: any lab-runtime (`c9s`) deploy of a topology with a host link (brief `endpoints: [host:eth1, r1:eth1]` or full `type: host`).
- Impact: the re-marshaled definition encodes the host link as `type: veth` with orphan `host-interface`/`endpoint` keys; when the definition is re-parsed (non-strict) into `clabtypes.Topology` by the c9s staging (`labruntime/clabernetes/files.go:124`) and by the controller compiler, `host-interface` and `endpoint` are not fields of `LinkVEthRaw` and are silently ignored, leaving a veth link with zero endpoints. `clabernetesBriefLinks` then emits a brief link with empty endpoints; the controller's brief-link parsing requires exactly 2 endpoints (`links/link_brief.go:20-25`), so the link is broken or the deploy fails. Pre-PR, the verbatim definition preserved the brief form and c9s parsed host links correctly.
- Correction: fix the root cause in `links/link.go` host case — `Type: string(LinkTypeHost)` — and add a round-trip check (parse → `labRuntimeTopologyWithExpandedMagicVars` → parse again) for brief host/mgmt-net/macvlan links in `core/labruntime_test.go`.

```yaml

host-interface: eth1
endpoint:
  node: r1
  interface: eth1
type: veth
```

Hmm wait, actually, I need to double-check how yaml.v2 handles `yaml:",inline"` on a struct FIELD (embedded struct) — yes, it promotes the embedded struct's fields.

Now re-parse: `LinkDefinition.UnmarshalYAML` → `type: veth` → `unmarshal(&l)` where l = {Type string, LinkVEthRaw inline}. yaml.v2 unmarshal is NON-STRICT here (plain Unmarshal used by c9s and by the controller compiler — the controller uses containerlab's parse; either way it's `yaml.Unmarshal` non-strict since `clabRuntimeConfig` parse at files.go:124 is non-strict). So `host-interface`/`endpoint` keys silently ignored. Endpoints nil.

Then `ToLinkBriefRaw` → `Endpoints: []` (line 25: initialized as `[]string{}` empty). Brief link with empty endpoints list. The controller compiler then calls brief parse → error "endpoint definition should consist of exactly 2 entries. 0 provided" (if it re-parses through ToTypeSpecificRawLink) — so deploy fails with a confusing error. OR the compile path may differ. Either way: broken.

Also — I should double check the definition parse by the CONTROLLER. The containerlab topology compiler "moved from clabernetes to containerlab" (rn/0.81) — `runtime.WithoutTopologyCR` compiles client-side in containerlab (`core/topology_reconcile.go`? or `labruntime`?). 33: // profiles carry the policy Nodes resolve, and Links must be complete before their Nodes so the
34: // node controller never plans against a partial wiring view.

68: 	}

98: 	}
99: 
100: 	return set, nil
101: }
